def slug_for_title(title: str) -> str:
    """URL slug for a product or campaign title."""
    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", ascii_title.lower())
    return "-".join(words)

def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """URL-safe identifier for a title: lowercased words joined by underscores."""
    return "_".join(re.findall(r"\w+", title.lower()))

def makeSlug(strTitle, maxLen=MAX_SLUG_LEN):
    """makes url friendly slug from a title"""
    if strTitle == None:
        return ''
    s = strTitle.lower().strip()
    s = re.sub('[^a-z0-9 -]', '', s)
    s = s.replace(' ', '-')
    while '--' in s:
        s = s.replace('--', '-')
    if len(s) > maxLen:
        s = s[0:maxLen]
    return s

from dataclasses import dataclass

from shopkit.utils.text import slug_for_title


@dataclass
class Product:
    sku: str
    title: str
    price_cents: int
    active: bool = True

    def is_purchasable(self) -> bool:
        return self.active and self.price_cents > 0

    @property
    def url_path(self) -> str:
        return "/products/" + slug_for_title(self.title)
